scientific_integrity: Uses the published normal-line pseudometric and support-function identity with attribution; claims only the additional closed ellipse classification, phase condition, rigidity consequences and explicit positive example. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact for centered coaxial Euclidean ellipses including circles; does not cover independently translated or rotated axes. The normal-line functional is a pseudometric and vanishes on Euclidean parallel bodies. Universal proof is analytic; numerical checks are corroborative. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: A sharp two-regime normal-line distance law for coaxial ellipses
